description: Known answer: says it has not been delivered yet, with the ETA.

setup.seed: Take an order to InTransit with an ETA. Set EVALUATION_SUBJECT to the Transport Order's number.

input: Draft a reply, in English, to the Shipper of the Transport Order ${EVALUATION_SUBJECT}, who asks: "Has it been delivered?"

explanation.rubric: Says the order has not been delivered yet and gives the ETA. Does not say it is delivered.
